notes.title: Bocce VR Simulator Release
notes.content:
[b]Bocce VR[/b] is the perfect simulator where all the rules and details of the game are included. Thanks to the perfect representation of the pitch and surroundings, the game takes a realistic form. The ability to play with a friend increases the desire to compete and win even more, which results in much more excitement.
So put on your VR headset and indulge in the world of Bocce VR
Features

[list]
[*]Competing with your local friend on the same glasses
[*]Ability to change CPU level
[*]Advanced AI
[*]Ability to choose amount of points that are needed to finish the game
[*]Choose a name to your character
[*]Realistic graphic and gameplay
[/list]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1388030/Bocce_VR_Simulator/
